answer: In this PoA network, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust matrix, whose EigenTrust-derived centrality is multiplied by temporal decay with an exponential half-life. Sustained honest service is therefore required to retain influence: a fresh sybil, whether named sparrow, prism, or ember, starts with near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted transitive support, and cannot accumulate enough weight to pass consensus.
